scope: Persist owner/parent-scoped, user-mediated A2A child lineage from a captured completed result to one separately approved successor.

implementation.migration: drizzle/0057_a2a_parent_sequence.sql adds predecessor_delegation_id and a unique partial index; a D1 trigger requires a same-owner, same-parent, remote_completed predecessor with captured artifacts.
implementation.ui: Zema follow-up draft retains the selected predecessor ID and renders the persisted source link after reload.
implementation.api: Successor creation rejects missing, foreign, incomplete, or uncaptured predecessors; one result cannot be branched into multiple successors.
implementation.recovery: The idempotent submission fingerprint and lost-response comparison bind the predecessor ID.
implementation.authorization: Each successor still requires its own signed quote, child cap, and explicit owner approval; source Agent authority is not inherited.
implementation.depthLimit: Maximum redelegation depth is 1. Store/API reject a successor-of-successor, and the D1 insert trigger independently refuses that lineage. Each later independent task must use a new parent job.

verification.schema: npm run schema:check: PASS; npm run database:check: PASS, source 6/6 and production readback 0/6
verification.api: npm run build && npm run test:api: PASS, 1024 Worker/D1 assertions and 113 CSV assertions
verification.fullSuite: npm run verify: PASS; Node tests 754/754, Fashion tests 19/19, production build, Worker/D1 API 1,024 assertions, CSV Worker/D1/R2 113 assertions.
verification.boundaries: Local fixtures and tests only. database status: source 6/6; current production readback 0/6.
verification.depthLimit: node --test tests/a2a-delegation-store.test.mjs tests/a2a-result-handoff.test.mjs tests/a2a-delegation-recovery.test.mjs: PASS, 29/29; includes full root→successor workflow, rejected third level in store, raw D1 insert trigger rejection, and API/source contract.
verification.limitations: Local fixtures/tests only. The database status check reports source 6/6 and current production readback 0/6.

notProven: Autonomous multi-step planning or agent-initiated recursive delegation; successor creation is user-mediated and does not dispatch.
Production D1 migration/readback, real Provider interoperability or invoices, funded settlement, carrier activation, or device OS installation.
